task.spec: Native Orca coordination smoke test A. You are an executor in a disposable Git worktree. Do not load improve, invoke pi-subagents/intercom, spawn workers, read application data or credentials, install packages, or publish. First record git status --short and your PI_PROVIDER, PI_MODEL, PI_REASONING_LEVEL names only. Use the injected Orca orchestration ask contract to ask your coordinator: Should the heading in smoke-a.md be Alpha or Beta? Wait for the actual answer; do not guess or ask via chat/Intercom. Write only smoke-a.md containing the answered heading and a sentence confirming you used the coordinator answer. Verify that no other tracked file changed, commit just smoke-a.md with message Add smoke A fixture, report commit/ref/cwd and ask reply evidence. Send worker_done once with the injected IDs and explicit outcome succeeded, then idle. Keep this small. Any lifecycle command failure means STOP and report exact evidence, not a fallback.
